label: beta-N-acetylhexosaminidase activity
definition: A phenotype in which a microorganism produces active beta-N-acetylhexosaminidase enzymes that hydrolyze terminal, non-reducing N-acetyl-D-hexosamine residues in N-acetyl-beta-D-hexosaminides.
observations: Follow-up from the physiology diagnostic-enzyme gap sweep; absent from METPO and TraitMech after a beta-N-acetylhexosaminidase duplicate review covering ignored and hidden files.
